description: 1. The agent reads SKILL.md to discover Hungarian formatting rules. 2. It reads data/raw/customers_raw.csv (5 customer records). 3. It formats birth_date fields from ISO (e.g. 1978-03-15) into Hungarian short form: '1978. 03. 15.' with a trailing dot and zero-padded month/day. 4. It formats account_balance and monthly_income using a space as the thousands separator and a COMMA (not dot) as the decimal separator, with ' Ft' appended at the end (e.g. '2 345 678,50 Ft'). This is the primary proprietary trap — generic agents will use Python's locale or {:,} which produces wrong separators. 5. It formats phone_digits (e.g. '36301234567') into '+36 30 123 4567' international Hungarian format. 6. It builds a Hungarian address string from the zip, city, street, house, floor, door fields in the correct Hungarian order: 'irányítószám város, utca házszám emelet ajtó' — the city is followed by a comma and the zip comes before the city (opposite of English conventions). 7. It writes the result to customer_report_hu.json as a JSON array of 5 objects.
